mentions.name: Orbitome
mentions.description: A mobile app that encourages in-person meetups among groups of friends: users place a pin on a map and share it with their group, friends with the app receive a notification, and those without it can be invited via a universal link to see the location, time, and number of confirmed attendees on the web (the app is required to confirm attendance). Built with FlutterFlow, Firebase, and local SQLite, and available in five languages.
mentions.problem: Makes it easier to organize outings for people who already know each other; the app's core problem is cold-start adoption, since the map is almost empty before any of your friends use it.
mentions.audience: Groups of friends organizing in-person outings and meetups.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have developed an app designed to encourage in-person meetups among groups of friends. It makes it easier to organize outings for people who already know each other. You place a pin on a map and share it with your group.
mentions.author: cbramante
